cases.name: b4c.axion_changes_the_tensor_but_not_the_cone
cases.notes: THIS IS THE POINT: same Fresnel cone does NOT imply the same constitutive tensor. W^{bd} = Z^{abcd}k_a k_c annihilates the axion piece IDENTICALLY, because a totally antisymmetric symbol contracted with the symmetric k_a k_c vanishes -- so the axion contributes nothing to W, nothing to its adjugate, and nothing to the light cone
